correctness.rationale: Reconstructed and checked directed rooted-forest determinant (n-s)I-1a^T; inclusion-exclusion gives conditional occupancy vector and boundary c=n. Exact regression increment c q^{n-c-2}/n is positive. Independent missing-target conditioning gives exact covariance n q^n(mu_n-mu_{n-1}); birthday-product domination proves all needed Rayleigh moments and mixed O(1) regression. Reproducibility checker directly enumerated all 50,068 maps for n=2,...,6 and independently verified finite exact identities through n=70. Tests corroborate analytic proof rather than replacing it.

Its explicit asymptotic results were inspected and do not state the claimed conditional parabolic finite-scale response or covariance constant. The 2010 paper handles conditioned component sizes, a distinct observable. The 1990 survey provides independent marginal expectations. None of the inspected stated results dominates the exact regression and sharp mixed covariance as a direct corollary.

originality.rationale: Targeted statement-level comparison of random-mapping joint image/cyclic statistics, full rooted-forest conditioning and leading mixed-moment terms. Hansen–Jaworski 2010 studies component sizes under cyclical-point conditioning; Arney–Bender 1982 studies indegree constraints and origin/mapping parameters; Flajolet–Odlyzko 1990 gives separate terminal and cyclic statistics. Neither the precise quadratic cycle-conditioned image response nor its sharp covariance coefficient was located in inspected primary sections. Classical implicit coverage is a documented residual risk, not an assertion of uniqueness.
residual_risks: Arney–Bender and older counting frameworks may implicitly generate the conditional origin law; derivability of the exact parabolic regression by a further calculation is possible.
Kolchin 1986 monograph and Rubin–Sitgreaves 1954 report were not inspected in complete text; concealed equivalent joint-statistic formulas are possible.
Indexed claim searches were semantic and cannot certify worldwide novelty, and no independent scientific validation was performed.

value.rationale: The precise joint behavior of basic global (cyclic points) and local (image occupancy) mapping observables is motivated by classical conditional random forest structure. The exact conditional full law is a reusable distributional reduction; the first-order O(sqrt(n)) dependence cancels, leaving a nontrivial parabolic O(1) shift and a positive O(sqrt(n)) mixed covariance with a vanishing O(n^-1/2) correlation. These are exact/sharp, structural relations not supplied by marginal expectation formulas alone.
